scope: Saved005 selected first20 families, development only; no recapture/rescore or competitive claim.
shared_source_order: neutral card key ascending; all family members retained; duplicates share evidence, never add slots

budgets.local_census: one shared complete local daily-export scan and read-only store lookup for all selected identities; same pass and vintage for both products

stop_rules: Every family receives original identity/description/status/family and attachment-inventory review under the same limits.

Fetch supplemental public resources only when local evidence does not resolve a material requirement/status/inventory question. Obvious scope mismatch stops with cited original requirement; no need to exhaust allowance.
Unresolved scope uses original linked SOW/PWS first, then original amendment/status. Never broaden to a new opportunity search.
Stop at source resolution, per-family deadline/file cap, restricted access or one failed attempt; retain exact gap and next action.
Changed sources mint new separately identified evidence; frozen packets, judgments and scores remain unchanged.
source_authority: Public original SAM notice/resources/files plus existing local export/store. No credentials, paid enrichment, GovTribe mirror authentication or LaCie restore.
promotion_policy: Raw bytes, locators, hashes, exact text offsets and clocks enable review; collection is discovery_only and does not itself approve Assess/LeadRow requirement evidence.
missing_clocks: filename date and filesystem observations are local export/read clocks; upstream acquisition/publication remain unknown unless independently supplied.
